answers.answer: cos 52°, because the two angles are complementary and swap the roles of opposite and adjacent

steps: In a right triangle, the two acute angles sum to 90°, so they are complementary.
The side opposite one acute angle is the side adjacent to the other.
Sine is opposite over hypotenuse and cosine is adjacent over hypotenuse, so sin θ = cos(90° − θ).
Therefore sin 38° = cos 52°.
